purpose: Coarse async cooldown candidate with motion ROI refresh, intended to preserve candidate_0028 stability while reducing refreshed area.
expected_effect: Limit motion-triggered refresh work to changed image regions.
Keep candidate_0028 zero-over-100ms behavior while reducing worker cost and cache disruption.
Expose ROI count and ROI pixels in leaderboard for validating local refresh behavior.
risk: Broad camera pan can produce a full-frame motion ROI; in that case the area cap rejects ROI refresh and falls back to full-frame async refresh.
ROI may miss localized changes and leave stale cached contours outside the ROI if the diff mask is too narrow.
Still inherits coarse color segmentation quality limits.
